title: Visual builder module Content field catalog

entries.summary: moduleCatalog() now lists Content fields, editor defaults, and carousel custom. Sanitize and public HTML render stay on type switches (lengths, URLs, HTML strip).
panel.js builds the Content tab from catalog fields; defaultModule clones catalog defaults. Media picker and carousel slides stay custom UI.
No schema change. Catalog is PHP code, not stored. Restored layout_json still holds each module’s data values.
cms-builder-drag-column-size selects the Left column heading and asserts Content field data-field=level.
